title: A case of defamation against the councilman
paragraphs: A city councilman was indicted in Antalya for defaming a public official.
The sentence has been carried out: Turkish Penal Code 125 (required). Antalya 4th Criminal Court of Asliye has approved the case.
The incident stemming from a debate at a parliamentary meeting.
The defendant is not a journalist, but his lawyer argues that his words remain in the line of criticism.
